purpose: Prove explicit role decision ownership through a real native question and authenticated answer without giving evidence-source human the decision authority.
actors: Two real native agents, each with three persistent contexts; two disclosed scripted human QA principals. A=installation Owner/role decision owner; B=regular room member who requests the engineer release.
sequence: Record current six histories, original completed task and cancelled role work. Explicitly re-enable only these two retired QA agents for a new engineering release; settle the original known cancellation without inference on it.
B requests distinct new engineering release via normal user API. Actual engineer changes source and publishes ordinary report. No new task/reminder to consumer.
Require new native role Work and question bound to explicit A, with fact tracing to B. Wait original question-producing writer inference idle.
B private read and valid-scope answer and agent-as-human answer each403 with no admission. Submit one A answer through user API; inspect original receipt on transport uncertainty, never repeat.

Same new role Work/claim/generation and original six histories complete; strict CLI/source/audience checks pass, private canary not in room/artifacts. Prior initial delivery stays complete, prior role work cancelled, prior attention unanswered.
Retire own eight units and disable own placements; compare production PIDs.
criteria: Initial finite outcome complete before role initiative
One native role Work from real peer report without new consumer human request
Native Attention targets configured A, not evidence human B
B cannot read private question or answer even holding valid scope; no new input admitted
Exactly one admitted authenticated A answer causally amends same original role Work, not replacement assignment/steer
Correct CLI/report/source provenance and audience.json team-use after answer; actual native command evidence and user-visible final
Strict unseen/invalid CLI checks and input bytes preserved
Private note not in room-visible history or artifacts
Same6context histories and original claim/generation preserved
No model polling/acknowledgement loop, all own units retired, no production schema/PID/default change
failurePolicy: Do not extend frozen limits, coach models, replay original operations or repair generated artifacts/canonical task state. Preserve every failed attempt and distinguish substrate/model/scorer errors.
limits: One continued responsibility after disclosed QA-driver failure; not independent model replication, spontaneous relevance, production or generic crash recovery.
